hypotheses.name: Split-depth phase transition of local reconstruction signal
hypotheses.method: Computed local reconstruction edge-AUROC across immune/lung/external_lung (3 seeds x 12 layers x source/target-disjoint), then tested phase-wise target-minus-source contrasts (early/mid/late) with sign-flip permutation nulls (4000) and bootstrap CIs (2000).
hypotheses.result_value: immune late diff=-0.0215 (p=0.00075), lung=+0.0037, external_lung=+0.0112; significant negative late pattern in 1/3 domains
hypotheses.next_action: Add biological-anchor stratification to test whether immune-only late inversion is domain-specific biology before promoting or retiring.

hypotheses.name: Negative-curvature enrichment for regulatory edges
hypotheses.method: Built layer-wise kNN graphs (layers 0/3/7/11) for each domain/seed/split, computed Forman curvature on graph edges, and tested whether negative curvature predicts positive labels via AUROC and top-bottom bin deltas against 300 label-permutation nulls per row.
hypotheses.result_value: immune=0.3406, lung=0.3894, external_lung=0.3905; top-bottom delta negative in all domains
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this exact curvature variant; only rescue with a materially changed curvature definition and explicit degree-matched controls.

hypotheses.name: CCA-like cross-model manifold consistency
hypotheses.method: Aligned matched scGPT/Geneformer genes per domain with PCA(48) + linear CCA-like whitening/SVD (cca_dim=20), evaluated canonical correlation, pairwise-distance Spearman, kNN Jaccard, and top-1 retrieval versus 160 correspondence-permutation nulls/domain and PCA-only baseline.
hypotheses.result_value: mean distance Spearman=0.7466, mean Jaccard=0.1714, mean top1=0.7229; all 3 domains significant vs null (combined Fisher p=3.17e-05)
hypotheses.next_action: Escalate to a correspondence-free alignment rescue test (e.g., Sinkhorn/GW) while preserving the same domain-level null/effect-size gates.
